Name: Si's Extra Crafting Materials
Author: SiTheGreat1
Description:
Adds a couple of new items that can be used by other mods for crafting, quests etc

[b]For Players[/b]
Just download this mod, unzip it, and place it in your mod folder.
You can edit the config (either directly in the config.json file, or via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]) to disable certain machine rules depending on your preferences. Use this if you want to avoid certain items being auto-used by mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url]. See the 'How To Make Items' section below for a full list of machine/crafting rules.

[b]For Mod Authors
[/b]You're welcome to use these items in your own mods! Just set this mod as a dependency and use 'Si.ECM_itemname' when calling the item in your crafting/machine/etc recipes, such as Si.ECM_chain and Si.ECM_mc. Each item also has a context tag, such as item_paper and item_ducttape.
See my mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25490]Write A Book![/url] for an example of another mod that uses items from this one.

[b]New Items
[/b][list]
[*]Chain
[*]Glass
[*]Glue
[*]Paper
[*]Rope
[*]String
[*]Leather
[*]Fiberglass
[*]Microcontroller (for mod authors: itemname is mc)
[*]Tape
[*]Duct Tape (for mod authors: itemname is ducttape)
[/list]
No new machines are added; this mod uses existing vanilla machines and resources to create these items.
All the items are Artisan Goods, and their sell price will benefit from the Artisan Profession.

[b]How To Make Items
[/b]All methods are enabled by default, and you can disable any of them from the config.
[list]
[*]Chain: place 1 Anchor into a recycling machine for 1 day
[*]Chain: place 1 Iron Bar into a loom for 2 days
[*]Glass: place 1 Glass Shards into a recycling machine for 1 day
[*]Glass: place 5 Broken Glasses and 1 Coal into a furnace for 1 day
[*]Glass: place 1 Obsidian and 1 Coal into a furnace for 1 day
[*]Glass Shards: place 1 Quartz or 1 Fire Quartz into a Bone Mill for 1 day
[*]Glue: place 100 Sap and 1 Coal into a furnace for 2 days
[*]Glue: place 20 Bone Fragments and 1 Coal into a furnace for 2 days
[*]Paper: place any 1 Dwarf Scroll into a recycling machine for 2 hours
[*]Paper place 1 Wood into a bone mill for 1 day
[*]Paper: place 1 Soggy Newspaper into a dehydrator for half a day; can make multiple papers
[*]Rope: place 10 of any Jelly (Sea, River, or Cave) into a loom for 5 days
[*]Rope: place 50 Hay into a loom for 5 days
[*]Rope: place 10 String into a loom for 2.5 days
[*]String: place 50 Fiber into a loom for 2 days
[*]String: place 10 Moss into a loom for 2 days
[*]String: place 1 Rope into a recycling machine for 2 days; makes multiple strings
[*]String: use the Crafting Menu to craft from 5 Thread
[*]Thread: place 1 Ornate Fan into a recycling machine for 2 days
[*]Thread: place 1 Duck Feather into a recycling machine for 1 day
[*]Thread: use the Crafting Menu to craft from 1 String; makes multiple threads
[*]Leather: place 1 Ancient Drum into a recycling machine for 4 days
[*]Leather: place 10 Bug Meat into a dehydrator for 4 days
[*]Microcontroller: place 1 Dwarf Gadget into a recycling machine for 3 days
[*]Microcontroller: place 1 Battery and 1 Refined Quartz into the Sewing Machine (Battery goes in the Cloth slot)
[*]Fiberglass: use the Crafting Menu to craft from 1 Fiber, 1 Glass, and 1 Glue
[*]Tape: use the Crafting Menu to craft from 1 Paper and 1 Glue
[*]Duct Tape: place 1 Tape and 1 Duck Feather into the Sewing Machine (Tape goes in the Cloth slot)
[/list]
[b]Translations[/b]
No AI translations please. This mod is i18n-compatible! Translators, you can either send me a translation file to be included in the main mod files, or maintain your own separate mod translation. If you choose to have your own separate translation mod, please ensure it requires my mod to be downloaded (either as a dependency or as a file replacer), and let me know once it's up. Thank you!

[b]Art Replacements
[/b]No AI art please. If you'd like to make and publish your own version of any of the art I created for this mod, feel free! Just set my mod as a dependency and let me know once it's up. Thank you!

[b]Bug Reports
[/b]If you encounter any bugs or issues while playing, please post them in the Bugs tab with a link to your SMAPI log. Include a SMAPI log even if you don't see any errors in the SMAPI window. Instructions for generating a SMAPI log are here: [url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi.io/log
[/url]
[b]Credits[/b][list]
[*]lllluby for the Chinese translation!
[/list]
